title: My Life in Bio
subtitle: My personal blog for recording things I've done, writing down my thoughts on miscellaneous topics, staying in touch with the internet.

posts.title: Stockholm, Sweden
posts.description: I just got back from an almost three week trip to Stockholm. I wanted to write up something similar to what I did for my Tunisa trip.

posts.title: Memories and moving
posts.description: One of the perks of moving is the novelty. You’re in a new residence and a new city. You’re meeting new people day-to-day. The people you spend the most time with almost certainly shifts. One of the perks of novelty is that it enhances your autobiographical recall. I’m simplifying, but you can read more about it here.
